name: Heatsinks
summary: Finned aluminium or copper blocks that pull heat away from chips, transistors and LEDs.
uses: Cooling MOSFETs, regulators and LEDs in builds
The hot side of a Peltier cooler
Heat pipes for small heat-moving projects
identify: Finned blocks on CPUs, power supplies, amplifiers, inverters, motor controllers and LED lamps. CPU coolers with copper heat pipes and a fan are the best finds.
test: Look for bent fins and clean the contact face. Use thermal paste or a pad between the part and the sink.
